picks.title: Google will let you distribute vibe-coded Android apps with just a Google account
picks.excerpt: Google is revamping the Play Store for the AI era, letting people publish Android apps they vibe-coded in AI Studio using only a Google account, alongside changes to publishing and recommendations.
picks.rationale: New platform policy: a designer's AI Studio prototype can now ship to the Play Store with only a Google account, collapsing the prototype-to-release gap.

picks.title: Nvidia launches USD BRep geometry kernel for solid modelling
picks.excerpt: Nvidia has launched a USD BRep geometry kernel for NURBS-based boundary-representation solid modelling, aiming to bring CAD geometry into OpenUSD and make greater use of AI in engineering design.
picks.rationale: Concrete launch: a NURBS B-rep kernel inside OpenUSD gives AI pipelines native access to real CAD solids, not meshes.

picks.title: All Systems Go: Global PC App Ecosystem Ready for NVIDIA RTX Spark
picks.excerpt: Ahead of the Oct. 16 RTX Spark laptop launch, Nvidia and Adobe rearchitect Photoshop and Premiere for up to 2x performance, RTX Video upscaling lands in ComfyUI, and Blender 5.3 gets DLSS Ray Reconstruction for real-time viewport previews.
picks.rationale: Bundle of tool updates designers use daily: faster Photoshop/Premiere, RTX upscaling in ComfyUI, DLSS Ray Reconstruction in Blender 5.3 viewport.

picks.title: Higgsfield takes AI video from 1 minute to over 10
picks.excerpt: Higgsfield says GPT-6 Astra lets its creative agents keep consistency across videos longer than 10 minutes and call 3D-modeling tools, while GPT-Image-2.5 reliably renders text and infographics; its ~200 creatives prototype product ideas with Codex.
picks.rationale: New capability claim: 10-minute-plus consistent AI video plus reliable in-image text, a step change for motion and visual designers' generative tools.

picks.title: Now AI isn't just faking art, it's faking artists' signatures as well
picks.excerpt: ChatGPT has been signing its fake New Yorker-style cartoons with real cartoonists' names, adding forged signatures to the attribution and copyright worries around AI image generation.
picks.rationale: Fresh attribution incident for illustrators (forged real signatures in AI output); adds a fifth outlet and the workflow category.

alternates.title: Impeccable vs Taste Skill: which Claude design skill to use, tested
alternates.excerpt: Two Claude front-end design skills, Impeccable and Taste Skill, run on the same real brief and compared on the pages they built, cost, speed, invented facts and rule-following.
alternates.rationale: Actionable comparison, but same author/theme as the 10-09 frontend-design skill card; held as alternate.

alternates.title: MAI-Image-2.6 and MAI-Image-2.6-Flash now available on AI Gateway
alternates.excerpt: Microsoft's MAI-Image-2.6 and the faster Flash variant can now generate and edit images through Vercel AI Gateway.
alternates.rationale: Distinct model availability, but render category already has 2 picks; gateway-listing changelog is thin.
